app.title: ZooWorkers
app.subtitle: A Cozy Animal Office Idle Game
app.tagline: A whole office of adorable animals runs one very small company.

opening.line: Every empire starts with one nut.
opening.titleNote: Cozy progress, chaotic coworkers, and one very important spreadsheet.
opening.spill: …and immediately spills coffee on the spreadsheet.

nuts.d: Your main currency. Earned passively and by collecting crates. Spent on upgrades, hires and decorations.

golden.d: Rare premium currency from milestones and prestige. Buys powerful upgrades and skills.

morale.d: Team happiness. Higher morale boosts production; coffee, decorations and good events raise it.

reputation.d: Grows as you produce. Unlocks new rooms and new teammates.

rate.d: Nuts produced per second across every room right now.

quiet.d: Softens audio and animation for calm, low-distraction play.

tip.friendship: Grows when you chat, gift coffee and keep them happy. Higher friendship boosts their output.
tip.mood: How this teammate feels right now. Emotions gently nudge their output up or down.

mute.d: Instantly silence (or restore) all music, ambience and sound effects.

music.d: Mute only the background music. Sound effects, interface and event sounds keep playing.

tip.affinity: How well this teammate works in their current room. Move them to a favourite room for a production bonus.

nav.office: Your cozy office and the team at work.
nav.shop: Buy upgrades to grow production and automation.
nav.employees: Hire, place and befriend your team.
nav.achievements: Goals to chase and their rewards.
nav.decorate: Buy decorations and arrange each room.

office.collectHint: A crate of nuts is ready!
office.decorateHint: Drag a decoration to move it, or drop it on the tray to stow it. Buy more in the Decorate tab.
office.dragHint: Drag a teammate onto a room to move them there.

decorate.resetFull: This room is packed — stow a few pieces, then tidy up again.
decorate.moveToHelp: Choose any unlocked compatible room. This is also the keyboard and touch alternative to dragging.
decorate.wrongRoom: That belongs in {{room}} — drop it there.
decorate.dragToPlace: Drag onto the highlighted floor or wall.

reject.occupied: That spot's already taken — try just beside it.
reject.coversTeammate: That would cover a teammate — give them room.
reject.moveInside: Move it farther inside the room.
reject.incompatibleRoom: That decoration can't be placed in this room.

decorate.roomEmpty: No decorations for this room yet.
decorate.pickedHint: Tap an empty spot to place it, or tap it again to cancel.

decoReact.plant: This little plant really freshens up the place.
decoReact.lamp: Cozy lighting makes all the difference.
decoReact.poster: Love what they did with the wall.
decoReact.rug: Ooh, this rug is so soft underfoot.
decoReact.aquarium: The fish are so calming to watch.
decoReact.trophy: We earned that — makes me proud.
decoReact.cushion: Just five more minutes on this…
decoReact.screen: Numbers look good on the big screen today.

shop.title: Upgrade Shop
shop.empty: Earn more nuts and reputation to unlock upgrades.

employee.byDepartmentTip: Send each teammate to their home department room.
employee.spreadTip: Distribute the team evenly across all unlocked rooms.

pip.name: Pip
pip.story: Pip started this company with one acorn and an unshakeable belief that meetings can fix anything. Confidence: maximum. Competence: negotiable.
pip.goal: Build the world's largest nut empire (and finally finish a spreadsheet).

marlow.name: Marlow
marlow.story: Marlow the capybara has never once raised their voice, panicked, or blinked during a crisis. Morale rises simply by being near them.
marlow.goal: Ensure absolutely everyone gets a proper nap.

rizzo.name: Rizzo
rizzo.story: Rizzo can find anything the company needs. Also several things it didn't. Please do not ask where the stapler went.
rizzo.goal: Source everything at a suspiciously good price.

bea.name: Bea
bea.story: Bea believes every problem can be solved with more wood. The chairs are now 40% sturdier and 60% more wooden.
bea.goal: Reinforce every single thing in the building.

corvus.name: Corvus
corvus.story: Corvus the crow has big ideas, most of them legally questionable, all of them extremely shiny.
corvus.goal: Make the nut brand go viral. Ethics optional.

mina.name: Mina
mina.story: Mina digs. Sometimes into the future of nut technology, sometimes into the meeting room, always with enthusiasm.
mina.goal: Discover what's beneath the basement's basement.

nixie.name: Nixie
nixie.story: Nixie the mouse thinks faster than she talks and builds machines from staplers, rubber bands, and pure confidence. Roughly 80% of them work.

otto.name: Otto
otto.story: Otto the otter keeps the books immaculate — right up until something shiny floats by. Explains the budget beautifully, then chases a paperclip.
otto.goal: Balance the books without getting distracted by shiny things.

hazel.name: Hazel
hazel.story: Hazel the hedgehog reads every contract twice and secretly adores the office chaos. Prickly on the outside, delighted on the inside.
hazel.goal: Keep the company just barely on the right side of the rules.

junie.name: Junie
junie.story: Junie the rabbit is everywhere at once and booked three meetings deep. Crates move faster simply because she's already there.
junie.goal: Deliver everything five minutes early, forever.

moss.name: Moss
moss.story: Moss the owl works the quiet hours, notices what everyone else misses, and speaks mostly in gentle, slightly unsettling observations.
moss.goal: Watch over the company while it sleeps.

fenn.name: Fenn
fenn.story: Fenn the fox could sell a walnut back to the tree it fell from. Charming, ambitious, and just a little too persuasive.
fenn.goal: Close the biggest nut deal in company history.

pingo.name: Pingo
pingo.story: Pingo the penguin keeps every parcel, pallet and nap perfectly scheduled. Cool under pressure, warm at heart.
pingo.goal: Route a thousand crates without a single delay.

canela.name: Canela
canela.story: Canela the red panda watches, notes, and protects — endlessly curious about how every little thing in the office works.
canela.goal: Fill an entire notebook with office observations.

nino.name: Nino
nino.story: Nino the office cat runs the meeting room with a purr and an iron paw. Somehow everything gets scheduled around his naps.
nino.goal: Attend every meeting without ever staying fully awake.

bia.name: Bia
bia.story: Bia the bear guards the vault and fixes what's broken with equal calm. Big paws, bigger heart — do not touch the honey stash.
bia.goal: Keep the vault safe and the snack shelf fully stocked.

quincy.name: Quincy
quincy.story: Quincy the frog catches bugs before anyone else notices them, with a tongue faster than any keyboard.
quincy.goal: Squash every last bug in the pipeline.

dorm.name: Sonny
dorm.story: Sonny the sloth reminds everyone that slow is smooth and smooth is fast. Eventually.
dorm.goal: Take the longest, most restorative break in history.

inky.name: Inky
inky.story: Inky the octopus sorts eight things at once and still has a tentacle free for coffee.
inky.goal: Sort the entire backlog before the coffee cools.

echo.name: Echo
echo.story: Echo the bat does her best thinking upside down, after everyone else has gone home.
echo.goal: Map every quiet corner of the night shift.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.story: Rosa the flamingo turns every launch into a runway. If it isn't fabulous, it isn't finished.
rosa.goal: Make the whole company impossibly stylish.

perry.name: Perry
perry.story: Perry the platypus sources the unsourceable. Part accountant, part secret agent, all business.
perry.goal: Track down one of everything, just in case.

axel.name: Axel
axel.story: Axel the axolotl meets every problem with a smile and the certainty that anything can grow back.
axel.goal: Discover something no one has ever grown before.

founderDesk.name: Founder's Desk
founderDesk.desc: Where it all began. One desk, one dream, one very tired squirrel.

sorting.name: Nut Sorting Department
sorting.desc: Good nuts left, broken shells right. Mostly.

morale.name: Coffee & Morale Division
morale.desc: Beanbags, snacks, and Marlow's calming presence.

procurement.name: Procurement Burrow
procurement.desc: Rizzo's domain. Inventory counts are… approximate.

construction.name: Construction Wing
construction.desc: Bea's workshop. Smells like fresh sawdust and ambition.

research.name: Human Behavior Observation Room
research.desc: For science. Definitely just for science.

meeting.name: Very Serious Meeting Room
meeting.desc: Where meetings about meetings are scheduled.

nap.name: Employee Nap Chamber
nap.desc: Productivity through rest. Marlow's proudest achievement.

basement.name: Suspicious Basement
basement.desc: There is definitely nothing weird down here.

rooftop.name: Rooftop Acorn Garden
rooftop.desc: Fresh air, actual grass, and a great view.

cadence.charge: Charged — pays more with a beat between taps

tip.synergy: Boosted by {{names}} working in this room.

nutCrate.name: Nut Crate
nutCrate.hint: The original revenue stream. Pry it open, take the nuts.

sortingChute.name: Sorting Chute
sortingChute.hint: Feed it steadily and it never jams. Probably.

coffeeUrn.name: Communal Urn
coffeeUrn.hint: Refills itself. Nobody has admitted to refilling it.

purchaseLedger.name: Purchase Ledger
purchaseLedger.hint: Every line signed twice. One signature is not yours.

shellPress.name: Shell Press
shellPress.hint: Heavy work. Let the ram reset before the next pull.

centrifuge.name: Behaviour Centrifuge
centrifuge.hint: Spins a sample until it admits something.

depositWheel.name: Deposit Wheel
depositWheel.hint: Turns smoothly. Sounds like it is counting.

observationTerminal.name: Observation Terminal
observationTerminal.hint: Logs a finding each time. Some findings log themselves.

agendaBell.name: Agenda Bell
agendaBell.hint: Rings to advance the agenda. The agenda has no final item.

dreamLog.name: Dream Log
dreamLog.hint: Records what the nap room hears. Please do not read page 4.

furnaceValve.name: Furnace Valve
furnaceValve.hint: Pays in gold. Asks no questions. Neither should you.

signalDish.name: Signal Dish
signalDish.hint: Aimed at the car park. Receiving anyway.

production.name: Production Line {{tier}}
production.desc: Streamline the nut pipeline. +10% nut production per level.

furniture.name: Ergonomic Furniture {{tier}}
furniture.desc: Comfier chairs, happier squirrels. +6% production per level.

coffee.name: Coffee Upgrade {{tier}}
coffee.desc: Better beans, better focus. +8% production per level.

quality.name: Process Quality {{tier}}
quality.desc: Fewer broken shells. +5% production per level.

click.name: Sorting Gloves {{tier}}
click.desc: Collect crates faster. Increases click power.

autoCollector.name: Auto-Collector
autoCollector.desc: Automatically banks a fraction of production. No clicking required.

conveyor.name: Conveyor Belt
conveyor.desc: Nuts move themselves. +15% production per level.

offlineCap.name: Cold Storage {{tier}}
offlineCap.desc: Store more offline nuts. +2h offline cap per level.

reputationEngine.name: Reputation Engine
reputationEngine.desc: Grow the company's good name faster.

moraleCap.name: Morale Ceiling
moraleCap.desc: Raise the maximum morale of the office.

sorting.name: Build: Nut Sorting Department
sorting.desc: Unlock a whole new floor for sorting nuts.

vault.name: Build: Golden Nut Vault
vault.desc: Unlock the glowing Golden Nut Vault.

meeting.name: Build: Meeting Room
meeting.desc: Unlock the Very Serious Meeting Room.

event.noEffects: Nothing measurable changed — but the story continues.

fallback.postpone: Postpone it and buy the team snacks
fallback.declineReaction: The paperwork sighs, but the office remains operational.
fallback.postponeReaction: The team accepts snacks as a legally binding extension.

printer.title: The Printer Is Making Demands
printer.body: The office printer has drafted a list of demands. Item one: respect.
printer.peaceBody: You reach an accord. The printer prints a tiny peace treaty. Production feels smoother.
printer.revengeBody: The printer was not unplugged. The printer remembers. It always remembers.

audit.title: Emergency Nut Audit
audit.body: An auditor arrives to count every single nut. This will take a while.

rizzoFound.title: Rizzo Found Something
rizzoFound.body: Rizzo is holding a box behind their back and grinning suspiciously.
rizzoFound.boxBody: Inside the box: a nut you've never seen before and a receipt with your name on it.

meeting.title: Mandatory Optional Meeting
meeting.body: Attendance is optional but strongly, aggressively encouraged.

coffeeAI.title: The Coffee Machine Has Achieved Consciousness
coffeeAI.body: The coffee machine has thoughts now. And feelings. And opinions about your KPIs.

pieChart.title: Extremely Important Pie Chart
pieChart.body: Pip presents a pie chart. It is a picture of an actual pie. Everyone claps anyway.

pigeon.title: A Pigeon Has Entered the Building
pigeon.body: A pigeon is here. It seems to want a job. It has a tiny resume.

beaWood.title: Bea Added More Wood
beaWood.body: Bea has improved the furniture with additional wood. It is now the woodiest office in town.

fire.title: The Office Is Technically On Fire
fire.body: It's a small fire. Very manageable. Marlow hasn't even looked up.
fire.livestream: Turn it into a marketing livestream

casualFriday.title: Casual Friday Became Too Casual
casualFriday.body: Everyone came in pajamas. Productivity is unclear but morale is soaring.

nutcoin.title: Corvus Launched NutCoin
nutcoin.body: Corvus has invented a cryptocurrency backed entirely by vibes and acorns.
nutcoin.crashBody: NutCoin has crashed. Corvus is already pitching NutCoin 2. You keep the story, at least.

minaBasement.title: Mina Found the Basement's Basement
minaBasement.body: Mina dug down and found a second basement below the first. It hums.
minaBasement.deepBody: Down here there's a faint golden glow and a very old spreadsheet.

goldenAcorn.title: The Golden Acorn Incident
goldenAcorn.body: A perfect golden acorn rolls across the floor, glinting like opportunity itself.

employeeMinute.title: Employee of the Minute
employeeMinute.body: The award goes to someone who did absolutely nothing, but did it with confidence.

replyAll.title: Someone Replied All
replyAll.body: A single 'thanks!' has been sent to the entire company. The chain grows.

chairPromoted.title: The Chair Has Been Promoted
chairPromoted.body: Due to a clerical error, the squeaky office chair is now a Senior Manager.

merger.title: A Very Small Corporate Merger
merger.body: A single-squirrel startup wants to merge. Their entire company fits in a mug.

stapler.title: The Great Stapler Disappearance
stapler.body: The stapler is gone. Rizzo is whistling. This is fine.

metaMeeting.title: Pip Scheduled a Meeting About Meetings
metaMeeting.body: The agenda is the agenda. There will be a follow-up about the follow-up.

union.title: The Union Wants Better Snacks
union.body: The employees have unionized around a single demand: superior snacks.

mascot.title: The Company Mascot Is Also Pip
mascot.body: After extensive deliberation, the new company mascot is revealed to be… Pip.

walnut.title: A Mysterious Walnut
walnut.body: A walnut appears on the desk with no explanation. It feels important.

human.title: Bring Your Human to Work Day
human.body: An employee brought their human. The human is very large and very polite.

spreadsheet.title: The Spreadsheet Knows Too Much
spreadsheet.body: A spreadsheet has appeared with data that predates the company. Cell A1 reads: 'hello'.
spreadsheet.answerBody: The spreadsheet answers in perfect formatting. It offers you a secret optimization.

existential.title: Quarterly Existential Crisis
existential.body: Everyone pauses to wonder what nuts even are, really.

sunglasses.title: Everyone Wore Sunglasses
sunglasses.body: For no clear reason, every employee arrived wearing sunglasses. The office is 200% cooler.

nixieMachine.title: The Keyboard Is Typing Before Anyone Touches It
nixieMachine.body: Nixie's latest contraption is finishing everyone's reports for them. It seems helpful. It is definitely watching.
nixieMachine.whirBody: The machine whirs, prints a flawless quarterly report, and a tiny thank-you note.

ottoAudit.title: The Accounting Department Found a Negative Nut
ottoAudit.body: Otto is holding a nut that, by every measure, has negative value. The ledger is sweating.

hazelLoophole.title: The Company Logo Is Legally Too Round
hazelLoophole.body: Hazel found an obscure rule: the logo exceeds the maximum permitted roundness. Technically.

junieSchedule.title: Someone Scheduled a Meeting During Nap Time
junieSchedule.body: Junie found a meeting booked squarely over the sacred Nap Chamber hour. Chaos brews.

mossNight.title: The Rooftop Wind Chime Is Predicting Market Trends
mossNight.body: Moss reports that the wind chime chimed exactly three times before every good quarter. It just chimed three times.
mossNight.omenBody: The chime spells out a suspiciously specific investment tip in the breeze.

fennDeal.title: A Client Wants a Refund in Walnuts
fennDeal.body: Fenn negotiated a huge sale, but the client now demands the refund policy be paid entirely in walnuts.

breakRoom.title: The Break Room Has Declared Independence
breakRoom.body: A handwritten flag now hangs over the snack table. The break room has seceded.
breakRoom.treatyBody: The break room's ambassador (a very confident squirrel) proposes a snack treaty.

acornWater.title: Someone Replaced the Coffee with Acorn Water
acornWater.body: The coffee tastes... earthy today. Suspiciously earthy. Nobody is confessing.

staplers17.title: Rizzo Has Acquired Seventeen Identical Staplers
staplers17.body: There are now seventeen identical staplers in procurement. Rizzo insists this is normal and necessary.

elevator.title: The Elevator Only Travels Sideways
elevator.body: The elevator has decided that up and down are overrated. It now travels exclusively sideways.

vaultHum.title: The Golden Nut Vault Is Humming
vaultHum.body: A low, pleasant hum is coming from the vault. The golden nuts appear to be… content.

fakeAward.title: Nominated for an Award That Does Not Exist
fakeAward.body: The company has been nominated for 'Best Nut Synergy 2026.' The awarding body cannot be located.

slogan.title: A Competitor Stole the Company Slogan
slogan.body: A rival firm is now using 'Working Our Nuts Off.' The nerve. The audacity. The near-identical font.

namedNuts.title: Every Nut in Storage Has Been Assigned a Name
namedNuts.body: Someone has lovingly named all 40,000 nuts in storage. Shipping them now feels… personal.

ghost.title: The Office Ghost Wants Dental Benefits
ghost.body: The office ghost has filed HR paperwork requesting dental coverage. It does technically have teeth.

coffeeLeave.title: The Coffee Machine Is Requesting Paid Leave
coffeeLeave.body: The (now sentient) coffee machine has requested a well-earned vacation. It has been working overtime.
coffeeLeave.deny: Ask it to stay one more week

meetingEmail.name: This Meeting Could Have Been an Email

corporateCashew.name: Corporate Cashew
corporateCashew.desc: Curved to fit any org chart.

suspiciousPistachio.name: Suspicious Pistachio
suspiciousPistachio.desc: Already slightly open. Who did this?

walnut.name: Legally Distinct Walnut
walnut.desc: Any resemblance to other walnuts is coincidental.

forbiddenPeanut.name: Forbidden Peanut
forbiddenPeanut.desc: Technically a legume. We don't talk about it.

executiveHazelnut.name: Executive Hazelnut
executiveHazelnut.desc: Golden, glossy, and rarely in the office.

almond.name: Emotional Support Almond
almond.desc: Always there when you need it.

brazilNut.name: Quarterly Brazil Nut
brazilNut.desc: Appears exactly four times a year.

stakeholderCashew.name: Stakeholder Cashew
stakeholderCashew.desc: Wants to be looped in on everything.

goldenKernel.name: Golden Kernel
goldenKernel.desc: The purest form of nut wealth.

cryptoNut.name: Crypto Nut
cryptoNut.desc: Value fluctuates wildly. Backed by vibes.

legacyHazelnut.name: Legacy Hazelnut
legacyHazelnut.desc: Nobody knows how it works, don't touch it.

visionaryPistachio.name: Visionary Pistachio
visionaryPistachio.desc: Sees a future no one asked for.

founderAcorn.name: Founder Acorn
founderAcorn.desc: The one that started it all.

prestige.title: Go Completely Nuts
prestige.explain: Reset your company to earn Permanent Kernels. Keep your collections, cosmetics, achievements, employee memories, and skill tree.

industrial.name: Industrial Nuts
industrial.desc: Maximum output, minimal comfort. +35% production, lower morale.

cooperative.name: Cozy Cooperative
cooperative.desc: Everyone's happy. High morale, gentle bonuses.

science.name: Questionable Science
science.desc: Breakthroughs and side effects. More rare events.

marketing.name: Aggressive Marketing
marketing.desc: Hype above all. Big rare-event chance.

underground.name: Underground Operations
underground.desc: What happens in the basement stays in the basement.

headStart.name: Head Start
headStart.desc: Begin each run with bonus nuts.

refinery.name: Kernel Refinery
refinery.desc: Earn more Permanent Kernels on prestige.

focus.title: Focus Harvest
focus.intro: An optional, supportive focus companion. Start a session and Pip's team works a little harder while you concentrate.
focus.disabled: Focus Harvest is currently disabled. Enable it in Settings.
focus.complete: Great focus! Pip is proud of you.
focus.privacy: This never blocks your computer and never inspects what you do. It only tracks the session timer.

microgame.title: Micro-games
microgame.rewardBoost: Nuts earned + a 90 second productivity boost

coffeeRescue.name: Coffee Rescue
coffeeRescue.desc: Move the mug with your pointer or arrow keys to catch each falling coffee drop. With reduced motion, tap each drop instead.
coffeeRescue.reaction: Pip hugs the warm mug. Productivity has been rescued.
coffeeRescue.controls: Coffee counter. Focus here, then use Left and Right Arrow to move the mug.

bugSquash.name: Bug Squash
bugSquash.desc: Tap the office pests the instant they pop up — quick paws build a combo!
bugSquash.reaction: The IT desk is bug-free. The bugs have filed a complaint.
bugSquash.empty: Empty drawer — no points to deduct

cableUntangle.name: Cable Untangle Desk
cableUntangle.desc: Drag the numbered plugs until no cables cross or overlap. Clear every tangle to finish.
cableUntangle.reaction: Every cable runs clear. Marlow is trying not to cry with joy.
cableUntangle.goal: Move any plug to reshape its two cables
cableUntangle.clearStatus: No crossings or overlaps — desk clear!
cableUntangle.hint: Drag plugs until no cables cross or overlap. Focus a plug and use arrow keys for fine control.
cableUntangle.doneHint: No tangles. Loading the next desk…

overview.capacityTip: Teammates working here. Every room holds up to six before it's full.
overview.comfortTip: Bonus morale from this room's decorations.

nextStep.claimDaily: A daily challenge is ready to claim!
nextStep.upgrade: You can afford a new upgrade.
nextStep.prestige: You're ready to Go Completely Nuts!
nextStep.decorate: You can afford a new decoration.

window.minimizeTip: Tuck the window down to the taskbar.
window.maximizeTip: Fill the screen — click again to restore.
window.restoreTip: Shrink back to the previous window size.
window.closeTip: Saves your game and window size, then quits (or hides to the tray if you enabled that).

photo.tagline: Another cozy day at the office

company.title: Company Overview
company.timelineEmpty: No big decisions yet — events will appear here.

icon.title: Company logo
icon.desc: Pick the emblem that represents your company.
icon.tip: Click to choose your company logo.

settings.title: Settings
settings.audioNote: Master controls everything. Each channel has its own volume and a mute button. Muting keeps your volume so unmuting restores it.

bg.title: Office Background
bg.note: The animated office that fills the main tab. Turn it off, dim it, or use a static image to save battery.

hint.alwaysOnTop: Keep the game window above your other apps.
hint.clickThrough: Let clicks pass through the window to whatever is behind it.
hint.launchOnStartup: Open the game automatically when your computer starts.
hint.closeToTray: The close button hides to the system tray instead of quitting.
hint.batterySaver: Ease off animation and background work to save power.

settings.resetConfirm: This erases all progress (cosmetics too). Are you absolutely sure?
settings.idleNote: Activity detection only checks how long the computer has been inactive. It never records keystrokes, text, app content, screenshots, clipboard, or any private information.
settings.browserNote: Desktop-window options are only available in the desktop app.
settings.autoResolveEventsOn: Choice events will not interrupt you. The department picks the best available option, applies the real consequences, and reports each decision in your notifications.
settings.autoResolveEventsOff: Choice events pause the office and ask you to decide.

onboarding.step1: The glowing crate is ready to collect. Grab it whenever you pass the office — production continues between visits.
onboarding.step2: Spend nuts on Upgrades to improve production, automation, comfort, and the rooms your company can reach.
onboarding.step3: Click Pip for a quick morale boost. Every teammate has moods, favourite rooms, stories, and friendship to discover.
onboarding.step4: Company records your growing empire, while Collections, Achievements, and Stats preserve the delightful details of every run.
onboarding.step5: On desktop, resize or dock this little office wherever it fits your day.
onboarding.step6: Always-on-top keeps the team nearby while you work — completely optional and easy to change in Settings.
onboarding.step7: Need calm? Quiet Mode softens sound and motion, and accessibility options let you tune the experience at any time.

offline.title: While You Were Away
offline.capped: (offline cap reached — upgrade Cold Storage for more)

react.beaConcerned: Bea is concerned about the wiring.
react.beaProud: Bea reinforced something, just in case.
react.minaCurious: Mina wants to study this further.
react.pipProud: Pip pretends this was the plan all along.
react.nixieProud: Nixie is thrilled it worked (this time).
react.ottoDistracted: Otto approves, then wanders off toward something shiny.
react.junieReady: Junie already rescheduled everything around it.
react.mossKnowing: Moss says nothing, but seems to have known.
react.fennGrin: Fenn grins like the deal was always going to close.

dev.title: Developer Panel
dev.note: This panel only appears in development builds or when ?dev=1 is set.

pip: Every empire starts with one nut.
I've scheduled a meeting to discuss the meeting.
This is fine. Everything is fine. We're scaling.
Synergy! I don't know what it means but we have it.
Where is my coffee. Where IS my coffee.
I meant to do that. It was strategic.
Q3 is looking nutty. In a good way.
Let's circle back on that acorn.
We're not a company, we're a family. A nut family.
I read a book about leadership. Well, the cover.
Big things are coming. I can feel it in my tail.
Note to self: buy more nuts. And a nap.
marlow: Breathe in. Breathe out. The nuts will sort themselves.
There is no crisis a warm beverage can't soften.
You're doing great. Truly. Take a break.
I have never once been late, because I am always here.
Conflict resolved. I simply waited calmly until it stopped.
Everyone deserves a nap. It's in the handbook. I wrote it.
Stress is optional. Snacks are mandatory.
Let's all take a moment. A long, gentle moment.
I am the calm in the acorn storm.
rizzo: I found this. Don't ask where.
That stapler? Never heard of her.
I can get you anything. For a small… finder's fee.
Everything here is technically accounted for.
Oh this? It fell off a truck. A nut truck.
Procurement is just borrowing with confidence.
Trust me, the books balance. Eventually.
bea: You know what this needs? More wood.
I reinforced the chair. And the desk. And the mug.
This wall could be 30% more wall.
I built a shelf. It's for more wood.
Everything's better with a solid frame.
I don't trust anything that isn't load-bearing.
Sawdust is just tiny future furniture.
Give me a plank and I'll give you an empire.
corvus: This will go viral. Trust the shiny.
NutCoin to the moon. Probably. Legally distinct moon.
I made an ad. It's mostly me. You're welcome.
Engagement is up! With what, unclear, but up.
Everything's content if you're brave enough.
We need a slogan. 'Nuts: they're nuts.'
Disruption? I invented that this morning.
mina: I dug a little too far again. Sorry about the floor.
